# secobserve_product_group (Data Source)

Looks up a product group by id or exact name.

Note that products and product groups share one name space, so a name identifies at most one of either.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secobserve_product_group" "payments" {
  name = "Payments"
}

output "products_in_group" {
  value = data.secobserve_product_group.payments.products_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the product group. Supply either this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the product group. Supply either this or `id`. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `active_critical_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of critical severity.
- `active_high_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of high severity.
- `active_low_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of low severity.
- `active_medium_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of medium severity.
- `active_none_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of `None` severity.
- `active_unknown_observation_count` (Number) Number of active observations of unknown severity.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `license_policy` (Number) Id of the applied license policy.
- `products_count` (Number) Number of products in the group.
- `security_gate_active` (Boolean) Whether the security gate is evaluated. Null means the setting is inherited.
